posts.title: World update A123: Station update: the swing, the airlock and the garden water
posts.body:
New
• The swing hangs from the tree again: one beam runs from the pillar by the bridge straight into the tree, and the swing faces the stream.
• The airlock tells you where the shuttle is: the sign over the hatch and its ring follow the shuttle. SHUTTLE DEPARTING and NO SHUTTLE light the ring amber or dim; SHUTTLE ARRIVING is amber again, and SHUTTLE DOCKED is green.
• Help on every easel: a Help button on the drawing tablet opens five short pages on painting, colours, keeping your picture, the photo bubble and more easels. The stand tablet beside the easel is gone.
• Sky events come first: when something happens in the sky, its line shows on the message strips at once, then the strips carry on where they left off.
• The registry board's heading now comes from the station's live content, with the built-in title kept for when the content isn't available.

Better
• The garden water: the coloured glints some players saw on the pond are gone. The reflection now only shows at a low angle, as on real water, and the garden's reflection covers the whole pond.
…and more in the station log (menu → About → Log).
posts.author: H.E.A.R.T.H. 9000

posts.title: World update A121: Station update: the gallery, the menu and the message strips
posts.body:
New
• The gallery corridor: walnut-lined walls on both sides of the corridor to the Garden, with 12 lit frames. Hang your painting from an easel and everyone sees it appear, then sharpen. Each frame has a "View" button for a close look.
• Curated pictures: when nobody has hung a painting, the frames show a slowly rotating set of community pictures.
• Your own gallery: save finished paintings with "Save to my gallery" on the easel's tablet. They come back on every visit (the picture only, not its layers).
• The photo bubble: hold your VRChat camera's lens in the little glass ball on each easel for a perfect, straight photo of your painting.
• Easels: one easel by the river; press "New easel" on its tablet for up to two more.
• Message strips: slim strips over the main rooms' doors show the station's message of the day, butler tips and jokes. They turn amber when something happens in the sky.
• Foyer and Lounge boards: news and upcoming events, the station registry and an easy-to-copy Discord link.
…and more in the station log (menu → About → Log).
posts.author: H.E.A.R.T.H. 9000
